channel.title: The Long Way Round
channel.description: Trails, tents and weather that never happened.

item.title: Tested: the midge season, in weather it was not built for
item.dc:creator: Pat Ridge
item.description: Every guidebook mentions the midge season and none of them explain it. We turned back at four, which everyone agreed was sensible and nobody was happy about. Coverage notes the bingo angle.

item.title: A quiet argument for optimism
item.dc:creator: Pat Ridge
item.description: Every guidebook mentions the seventeen-mile detour and none of them explain it. Opinion remains split on whether optimism counts as a hobby or a grievance. Coverage notes the bingo angle.

item.title: Tested: the seventeen-mile detour, in weather it was not built for
item.dc:creator: Pat Ridge
item.description: The forecast promised sun; optimism promised otherwise and was correct. It rained sideways, then stopped, then reconsidered.
